summary: Xometry, Inc. filed a preliminary prospectus supplement (424B5) for a $225 million underwritten public offering of its Class A common stock on June 1, 2026. The offering price is to be determined via negotiation; the recent market price was $95.29 per share (May 29, 2026). Underwriters include J.P. Morgan and Goldman Sachs. The filing is a routine secondary offering, not a special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring. No special-situation events are triggered; it is a standard equity capital raise for general corporate purposes. As a result, this filing does not fit any special-situations category.
